text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...My skin is broken out. 
How shameful for one who bears the Garden 
upon her shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Inner Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —Are you not conscious of being a flower?

text_block_list.name: Inner Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Then you know what must be done, yes?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—With the way of the flower etched upon my 
heart, 
I must restore this skin to jade-like 
perfection...!
